geometryDisclosure: Points are source-referenced place features, NOT verified entrance, parking or precise viewing locations; pad location is added only when source mission GPS is valid.

sites.name: Isla Blanca County Park
sites.coordinateRole: USGS published park feature center — not parking or a guaranteed viewing position
sites.accessNote: Cameron County manages the park. Daily entrance fees, launch-event gate times and capacity can change. County park-office hours are not a verified launch-day entry schedule.
sites.bestFor: The closest documented public island park setting
sites.scene: At the southern tip of South Padre Island, the shoreline faces over Brazos Santiago Pass toward the Starbase range. This is the popular public gathering place, not an exclusive viewing platform.
sites.tradeoff: Expect a congested Queen Isabella Causeway and park queues. The published park reference is not a signed parking entrance.

sites.name: Jaime J. Zapata Memorial Boat Ramp
sites.coordinateRole: US Department of Energy public environmental photo location at the boat ramp — not parking entrance
sites.accessNote: Cameron County lists this facility. Current opening hours, launch-specific parking rules and unobstructed pad visibility have not been independently confirmed.
sites.bestFor: A county-managed mainland reference without crossing to South Padre
sites.scene: On the mainland side of the Laguna Madre region, this county boat-ramp facility offers an alternative to island access. The listed feature location is not a surveyed rocket sightline.
sites.tradeoff: A farther reference can be an easier mainland plan, but this does not establish road travel time, night entry or a usable launch sightline.

sites.name: Port Isabel Lighthouse historic site
sites.coordinateRole: Texas Historical Commission published historic-site reference, not a launch-watching platform
sites.operator: City of Port Isabel / Texas Historical Commission
sites.accessNote: Climbing the lighthouse is ticketed and governed by published daytime or seasonal tour hours. Never assume access to the top, or public grounds, for a night launch.
sites.bestFor: Combine a Port Isabel visit with a mainland launch-watch plan
sites.scene: The nineteenth-century lighthouse recalls when this channel was navigated by a lamp rather than a launch computer. The historic site is a land reference, not a confirmed rocket-viewing terrace.
sites.tradeoff: Choose this for a cultural day stop. It has no mission-specific viewing authorization or proven unobstructed line of sight.
